SELECT p.nom, COUNT(*) AS commits
FROM commit_git c
JOIN depot d ON d.id = c.depot_id
JOIN projet p ON p.id = d.projet_id
GROUP BY p.nom
ORDER BY commits DESC

SELECT dossier, COUNT(*) AS notes
FROM note
GROUP BY dossier
ORDER BY notes DESC

SELECT source_id, cible_titre
FROM lien
WHERE cible_id IS NULL
ORDER BY cible_titre
